acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce pinned native Playwright browser timeout with successful actual DOM-ready marker and retain exact source, plan, receipt, runtime and process identity evidence.

Implement durable bounded owner-identity cleanup for native browser descendants that create separate groups; timeout and SIGINT/TERM retire browser/helpers and do not leave survivors after executor returns.

Actual normal completion, timeout and interruption qualification prove own-process retirement with no collateral host browser/session/profile signals or changes; failed/partial native observations remain incomplete, never criterion passes.

Retain original three-survivor evidence and manual containment separately; independent review and process identity/reuse negative checks validate the cleanup boundary before promoting this runtime tuple.
body:
Confirmed actual native lifecycle defect, not suspected and not an assertion-test failure. Playwright1.63.0 Node22.23.3 Chrome154.0.8037.59 on macOS arm64. Current compiled corvint-test-runner fixed Playwright Build/Execute/Parse/Normalize, pinned Node+Chrome auxiliary tools, isolated report HOME/TMPDIR and private Playwright user-data-dir. Native test opens Chrome, creates DOM, asserts its text, writes browser-ready marker, then waits120s; Request.timeoutSeconds=6. Native expected IDs are listed independently before run. Actual: common executor returns incomplete timeout/missing-report correctly, but Chrome created PGID8440 distinct from runner group; browser8440 plus two helpers survive and browser is reparented PPID1. A read-only process inventory retained exact own descendant identities. Expected: bounded cancellation retires every owned ordinary native browser descendant without touching unrelated browser profiles/groups. Normal mixed/pass runs retired all observed descendants. Manual identity-bound TERM to group8440 after matching PID, PGID, command and task-private user-data-dir retired all3; this is containment only, not a durable fix. Raw reproduction, exact native request/plan/tool pins and receipt below. Original failed proof remains evidence; no source repair or claim of qualified timeout cleanup. Dedup agent-memory groupreap matches0391/0392 concern pipe draining/Git sequencing, not this separate native browser group; Playwright matches0541/0211 concern verdict/selection, not lifecycle.
